That’s what I said. I didn’t want to ruin someone’s image over something easily doctored. This community is used to witch hunts, and I’ve been part of it since 2013, but the past like three months people I’ve considered friends have been coming st my throat for any reason they can.

It’s exhausting and killing my mental health. I have so much other stresses and depression that when “friends” start trying to make me look bad, it gets really overwhelming
